name: Molini di Triora (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Molini di Triora (a castle beneath a sun on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Molini di Triora, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 12 September 1953.

features.role: Molini di Triora arms — castle beneath a sun on blue, crowned, within branches
